Table_Delimited.description: X-ray beam locations in the target plane, and pixel positions in each MCC image

Field_Delimited.name: PMC
Field_Delimited.description: The PIXL Motion Counter is a counter representing a change to the PIXL Hexapod position. The counter increments by 1 each time the hexapod is moved.

Field_Delimited.name: x
Field_Delimited.description: The 'x' position of an X-ray beam location on the target, relative to the PIXL base frame.

Field_Delimited.name: y
Field_Delimited.description: The 'y' position of an X-ray beam location on the target, relative to the PIXL base frame.

Field_Delimited.name: z
Field_Delimited.description: The 'z' position of an X-ray beam location on the target, relative to the PIXL base frame.

Field_Delimited.name: geom_corr
Field_Delimited.description: A correction factor applied to the Beam Geometry Tool to account for the change in solid angle of the geometric quantification model when the target is not at the nominal distance.
